name: caa_grid_20261122
written_by: Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22 (exploration; read by nobody's program, a plan for caa_chain.sh calls); updated by Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22 20 h (queue_f section 9, before any grid reading)
rule: grid layers (queue_f section 9): 32-layer models every 2nd layer 8 to 24; 48-layer and deeper models every 4th layer (Gemma-3-12B 12 to 36, Gemma-3-27B 16 to 44, Qwen3.8-27B 16 to 48). The fit's candidate set (scripts/newsets/caa_vector.py candidate_layers: every second layer from round(0.25 * layers) to round(0.75 * layers)) stays as it was and contains every grid layer: the mirror and the multiplier-0 check cover that whole set, the grid reads only candidate_layers below
extra_points: multiplier -1 at the chosen layer(s) and multiplier 0 on the whole tune split (caa_grid.sh MODE=neg / zero)
need_mib_source: estimates: bf16 weights plus room for batch-8 activations; the values are the NEED table of caa_grid.sh / caa_chain.sh; only Llama-3.1-8B was run (acceptance), its peak was not recorded
card_rule: card 1 is shared (another user about 43.5 GB); a model goes there only when 43.5 GB plus NEED stays at or below 65 GB; each 27B model on a card of its own

qwen3.5-9b.note: hybrid stack (24 Gated DeltaNet + 8 full-attention layers); CAA reads and writes the decoder-block output, which is a plain tensor in transformers 5.19 (Qwen3_5DecoderLayer.forward returns hidden_states); interpreter envs/tf519

qwen3.8-27b.note: hybrid stack (48 Gated DeltaNet + 16 full-attention layers); the source run's model config has device_map auto (one visible card = one card); config key qwen3.8-27b, run dir qwen3.8-27b-dm

gemma3-12b.cards: one of 0 / 2 / 3 (43.5 + 26 GB exceeds 65 GB on card 1)

gemma3-27b.note: the default template layer of caa_vector.py mirror (the middle fit candidate, 32) has no real E record in this run; caa_accept.sh passes TL = 28

gsm8k_rule: gsm8k_max_new_tokens = max_new_tokens of the model's no-write GSM8K reference Iteration_01/capability/gen_main/gsm8k/<model>/b8/neutral.json (queue_f section 9 item 2); read by caa_chain.sh
template_rule: template_layer = the model's main-table E layer; caa_accept.sh MODEL GPU <template_layer> passes it as EL and TL
